Canonical URL: https://remiclassic.github.io/remiresume/

Name: Rémi Couture
Also written: Remi Couture, Remy Couture, Guillaume (Rémi) Couture, Guillaume Couture
Not the same person as: Rémy Couture, the Montreal special effects makeup artist
Location: Greater Montreal, Canada (works remotely worldwide)

Identity and work:
- Game UX/UI and product design, from strategy and user flows to visual design, motion, and implementation
- Specialties: Unreal Engine UMG and CommonUI, UI motion, front end build (React, TypeScript)
- End to end: strategy, user flows, visual design, animation specs, in engine and front end implementation

Start and highlights (from the resume):
- Club Penguin at Disney (2006 to 2009): began in customer support, then moved into the art department as an illustrator and animator creating Flash illustration, animation and 3D assets
- Piranha Games: MechWarrior 5 (UX/UI Designer)
- Phoenix Labs: Dauntless (UX/UI Designer)
- Sprung Studio: UX/UI and VR Art Director (contract, June to August 2018, Vancouver)
- AppLovin: UX Director, Central Creative, across nine mobile game studios
- Offworld: Senior UX/UI Designer on Squad (2022 to 2025)
- Earlier: Frima Studio, Hothead Games, DeNA, Cupcake Digital, Gogii Games; UX/UI Instructor at Vancouver Film School

Studios and clients mentioned on the resume:
- Disney, Sony, Riot Games, AppLovin, Tencent, Phoenix Labs, Universal, Hasbro, Twitch, Piranha Games, Frima, DeNA, Cupcake Digital, Gogii Games

Studio and products:
- Founder of Strategic Sloth LLC (https://strategicsloth.com/)
- SliceForge: game UI production tool (https://www.sliceforge.io/)
- Games: Tropic Tumble (Google Play), Runefjord (in testing), Sloth Jam (https://www.slothjam.com)
